name: S & J International Enterprises Public Company Limited
summary: S & J International Enterprises Public Company Limited, operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in the production and global distribution of various cosmetic goods, catering to markets both within Thailand and across the world. The company's business activities are categorized into three main divisions: Cosmetics, Packaging, and Other segments. Its comprehensive product range includes decorative makeup items, an array of skin, body, and hair care formulations, as well as perfumes and personal hygiene products. Furthermore, S & J International is actively engaged in the research and development of advanced cosmetic formulations. The firm was established in 1980 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand.
